prompts.name: library
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached dashboard object cutout. Preserve natural proportions, overall object placement and clear everyday-object silhouette. Direction: understated vintage stationery/workshop catalog photography with tactile worn materials and soft neutral lighting. Remove ornate or festive styling, not a Christmas image. Genuine transparent background including gaps, no background plane, no glow or colored edge spill. Square canvas with complete objects centered and about 12% transparent margin. No text, logos or watermark. Keep two upright old hardcover books in the same pose, but replace the red and green leather covers and ALL decorative gold ornamentation with plain faded dusty-blue book cloth on one and warm oatmeal linen book cloth on the other. Simple unembossed spines, gently frayed edges, aged ivory pages. No gilt, ornamental patterns, flowers, ribbon or leather.
